records.assetReview: All normal-intensity bars use 100 px/(W/m²): trial A is stacked 100+200=300 px, trial B 200+300=500 px, and the mean total is a separate 400 px bar. The final standalone switching-off diagram declares 100 px per normalized intensity unit: initial segments 100+300=400 px become an unchanged first segment 100 px. Thus removed fraction is 3/4 and original first-to-second ratio 1/3. Full XML and native image read; each stack has its own clear zero origin, equal scales within the compared group, and labels distinguish intensity from amplitudes or dB.
